insight: Backed by Y Combinator; built around an index of 250M+ research papers and other academic sources.
name: AnswerThis
tagline: AI research assistant for citation-backed answers and literature reviews.
description: AnswerThis searches academic literature and returns comprehensive answers with line-by-line citations linked back to the source papers. It drafts structured literature reviews, organizes a research library, and helps write research content grounded in verified sources rather than open-web text. A free tier covers everyday searching, with an Enterprise plan aimed at pharma, biotech, and medical-device teams.

modelSupport.notes: Runs LLMs over its academic-paper corpus; models not user-selectable.

edge: Answers and full literature reviews carry line-by-line citations tied to the originating paper, not just a source list.
